name: "Black Jack" Simmons
role: Miner back from the Coeur d'Alene
mentions: Jack Simmons, better known as "Black Jack" made Medora a flying visit yesterday. He is fresh from the Coeur D'Alene gold region. He reports great scarcity and costliness of provision…
Jack Simmons is in town direct from Coeur D'Alene. He likes the prospects but says that of all the mines located, only half a dozen are being worked, all the rest being in litigation…
